analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($317.46) vs SMA5 ($358.64)/SMA20 ($394.32)/SMA50 ($408.01): below short/mid-term trends, indicating a bearish phase.
· Below SMA100 ($463.81)/SMA200 ($376.52): mid-to-long-term trend weakness intensifying.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.5→32.8): entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0874→-6.6729): continued worsening, confirming bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $334.57): approaching lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($278.39): based on lower support near Pivot S1 ($265.14).
· Swing resistance ($365.90): based on upper resistance near SMA5 ($358.64), expecting short-term bounce if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low holding, 20-day low breached): confirming continued weakness.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (3.97x): suggests potential panic selling in a downtrend, increasing confidence.
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend): maintain a wait-and-see approach, prepare for further declines if 20-day low is breached.
